about: A club day's money postings, by transaction kind and ledger account code (debits positive), become one journal voucher per kind, in the order of the kinds' names (#96, decision 0187). Each kind's postings are summed by the Tally ledger its code maps to; codes mapped to one ledger net together, a ledger that nets to nothing is left out, and so is a kind with no lines left. Debit lines come first, the larger first, then by ledger name. Vouchers are numbered RIVR-<day>-<n> from 1. While any code posted that day maps to no Tally ledger, there is no file, and the codes are named. Postings are written 'kind code ledger amount' (a dash for no ledger), one per line; vouchers 'number kind: ledger amount, ...'.

cases.description: A day of buy-ins, cash-outs and rake: three vouchers, in the kinds' order.

inputs.postings:
buy_in member.cash Player deposits ₹-30,000
buy_in venue.cash Cash ₹30,000
cash_out member.cash Player deposits ₹12,000
cash_out venue.cash Cash ₹-12,000
hand_rake member.cash Player deposits ₹1,500
hand_rake venue.rake Rake income ₹-1,500

expected.vouchers: RIVR-20261115-1 buy_in: Cash ₹30,000, Player deposits ₹-30,000 | RIVR-20261115-2 cash_out: Player deposits ₹12,000, Cash ₹-12,000 | RIVR-20261115-3 hand_rake: Player deposits ₹1,500, Rake income ₹-1,500
